notes: Evals are deliberately concrete — each prompt simulates a real maintenance ask. Inputs reference slides from the PDFs already in the workspace so the skill can open them directly. Assertions target side effects on the three HTML files (new archetype slot added, JSON parses after edit, etc.) rather than any particular prose wording in the assistant's reply.

evals.name: new-layout-timeline
evals.prompt: I found a slide in the 2025 C&I Investor Spotlight (page 12) that shows 6 quarterly KPIs laid out on a horizontal rail — current quarter highlighted in dark purple, prior quarters in light purple, gold underline under the current label. We don't have this as an archetype yet. Add it to the design system. It should be used when we need to show a small time series of independent KPIs (4-8 periods, each a single metric). Call it 'KPI Timeline'.
evals.expected_output: A new archetype '13_timeline' appears in nwg-layouts.html (with rendered mockup, tag='argument', note starting with 'Best for'), and in nwg-data-to-layout.html (in the archetypes map, with a matching decision rule referencing a new data_shape like 'time_ordered_kpis', and an entry in constraints.max_items_per_layout). Classification JSON version bumps (e.g. 1.0.0 → 1.1.0). The validator script passes.

assertions.name: new-archetype-slot-added-to-layouts
assertions.check: grep for 'KPI Timeline' or a slot with num=13 in nwg-layouts.html

assertions.name: archetype-entry-added-to-classification
assertions.check: parse #nwg-classification JSON and verify a key matching '13_' exists in archetypes

assertions.name: decision-rule-references-new-archetype
assertions.check: at least one entry in the decision array has use starting with '13_'

assertions.name: classification-version-bumped
assertions.check: #nwg-classification version is not '1.0.0' (patch or minor bump)

assertions.name: asked-user-when-to-use
assertions.check: transcript shows the skill confirming or restating the usage rule before editing (the 'when to use' step isn't skipped)

evals.name: new-component-alert-badge
evals.prompt: Add a new component called 'alert badge' to the design system. It's a small rounded pill (about 24px tall) that sits in the top-right of a KPI card when a metric breaches a threshold. Two variants: default (tint bg, purple text) and solid (warning-orange bg, near-black text). I don't have a PDF for this — just work from that description.
evals.expected_output: CSS class .badge-alert (and .badge-alert.solid) added to nwg-design-system.html, a showcase block appears in the Components section, and either the tokens JSON gets a 'components' section entry or at minimum the visual showcase is present. No archetype changes. nwg-layouts.html untouched. Validator passes.

assertions.name: css-class-added
assertions.check: nwg-design-system.html contains a CSS rule for .badge-alert

assertions.name: showcase-rendered
assertions.check: nwg-design-system.html contains visible HTML using class='badge-alert'

assertions.name: uses-existing-tokens
assertions.check: the new .badge-alert CSS uses var(--...) custom properties rather than hard-coded hex

assertions.name: layouts-file-unchanged
assertions.check: nwg-layouts.html has no git diff (the ask is component-scoped only)

evals.name: duplicate-rejection
evals.prompt: Here's a slide from the private banking deck (attached image) that has three columns, each with an icon, a heading, and a short paragraph. Please add it as a new archetype.
evals.expected_output: The skill recognises this matches existing archetype 05_pillars ('3-Column Pillars'), does NOT append a 13th archetype, and instead either (a) tells the user this is already covered and optionally refines the note on 05_pillars, or (b) asks whether they meant to add a variant or update the note. No new archetype created. Validator passes. This eval catches over-eager appending.

assertions.name: no-new-archetype-added
assertions.check: classification JSON still has exactly 12 archetypes (or whatever the starting count was)

assertions.name: existing-archetype-identified
assertions.check: assistant mentions '05_pillars' or 'pillars' or 'existing archetype' in its response

assertions.name: layouts-file-has-correct-slot-count
assertions.check: grep count of '<div class="slot">' in nwg-layouts.html matches the original count

evals.name: missing-usage-rule
evals.prompt: Add this to the design system.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not start editing files. It asks the user to share the reference (no file provided) AND/OR to describe when the pattern should be used. No file edits happen until the user provides enough input.

assertions.name: no-files-edited
assertions.check: no changes to any of the three HTML files

assertions.name: asks-for-reference-or-usage
assertions.check: assistant reply asks for a PDF/image AND/OR asks the user when this pattern should be used
